caption: The drawing depicts a metallic object consisting of two hemispherical bowls joined together to form a closed sphere, with the upper hemisphere slightly overlapping the lower. The object is mounted on three straight legs that support the lower half. Two elongated handles, parallel to each other, extend from the right side of the hemispheres. The handles are aligned and appear to be fixed at the junction between the upper and lower halves. The entire object is rendered in shades of gray and black, with darker shading on the lower hemisphere and legs, representing shadows and depth. The drawing is centered on a blank, beige background, bordered by a hand-drawn rectangular frame. There are no additional objects or elements in the composition.
title: Coffee Roaster
